source: docs/oracle/BACKLOG.md (study list) and prototypes/ranch-atelier/dist/fritigern/overlays.js (STYLES) on the live branch. Reference titles are study targets, not copied assets.

styles.name: Clean
styles.summary: No framing at all: the world on its own, for building and free play.
styles.kidFit: Best for free building; nothing to read.

styles.name: Cinematic cut
styles.summary: 2.39:1 letterbox, vignette, a title card and an end card; the camera does the storytelling.
styles.kidFit: Easy to watch, nothing to read beyond the title; keep it under a minute for young children.

styles.name: Storybook read-aloud
styles.summary: A narrator reads to a child; big gentle subtitles; narration can be written into the world.
styles.kidFit: The default for children who can't read yet: everything is spoken, words are large and few.

styles.name: Game HUD
styles.summary: A small, light HUD with an objective line, a prompt and name tags over the things that matter.
styles.kidFit: Keep it to one objective and icons; read the objective aloud for non-readers.

styles.name: Telltale dialogue and choices
styles.summary: Episode card, speaker subtitles, a timed dialogue choice where silence counts, and a 'will remember that' notice.
styles.kidFit: Two or three choices with pictures, a generous timer or none, and the choices read aloud.
